about: Mind meld: two players get the same prompt and each types an answer without talking. Matching answers (ignoring case, plurals, 'the' and one typo) score 1,000 each. Prompts should have a few obvious answers, not one. wild prompts only play on No holds barred.
prompts: Something you take to the beach
An animal you'd see on safari
A sport played with a ball
A word that rhymes with cat
Something you do on a Sunday
Something you find in a handbag
A job that needs a uniform
A place to go on a first date
A word you'd shout at a football match
Something you'd find at a wedding
wild: Something you'd find on a walk of shame
Something that happens at an after-party
A body part people find sexy
A pet name for a lover
A reason to leave a party early
